title: Stephen R. Jordan, Editor

sections.h: Editor of The World of AI
sections.body: Stephen R. Jordan is the editor of The World of AI and the founder of SRJ Consulting & Services LLC, the Frisco, Texas company that publishes it. He decides what the site tracks, which sources it trusts and the rules its software follows, reviews what that software produces, and is responsible for everything published here. How that works in practice is set out in the editorial policy.

Jordan spent three decades in senior security, operations and risk roles before founding SRJ Consulting & Services in 2023. At Citi he owned Level 3 endpoint security across roughly 500,000 endpoints in 165 countries. At Intel and McAfee he led product security incident response, directed senior security architects, published CVEs to MITRE and stood up the Security Development Lifecycle. At Optiv, one of the largest pure play security advisories in North America, he scoped multi year enterprise engagements with chief information, executive and data officers. That work is why this site keeps a daily record of the CVEs filed against AI products, on the AI CVE tracker.

He holds a Bachelor of Business Administration in Accounting and a Master of Arts in Political Science, with a minor in business statistics, from West Texas A&M University, and completed postgraduate studies at East Texas A&M University in higher education curriculum and supervision, computer science, and educational media and technology.

Jordan is the author of The Operating Discipline for AI Library™, a book series on running artificial intelligence as a managed business function, published by SRJ Consulting & Services Publishing and available in hardcover, paperback and Kindle. Where a page on this site draws on one of his books, the page says so.

SRJ Consulting & Services sells advisory work on AI governance, risk and security; it sells no software and holds no vendor partnerships. Jordan also co-owns Jordan & Jordan Insurance Group, and the AI Insurance section of this site draws on that experience and says so. No commercial relationship changes a ranking, a legal status, a case summary or a verdict on this site; the disclosure page sets out what is paid.

To report an error or reach the editor, write to theworldofai@inkboxmail.com or use the contact page, and name the page. Confirmed errors are corrected on the page itself, as described under Data Quality and Corrections. Professional profile: LinkedIn.
